name: CMS Price Transparency Platform
description: The CMS Price Transparency Platform ingests machine-readable hospital price files mandated by the US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (2021 rule) and transforms them into a searchable, filterable analytics interface. Features ETL pipeline handling multi-gigabyte CSV/JSON files, PostgreSQL storage with indexed procedure codes, and a React-based cost comparison dashboard. Enables patients and researchers to compare insurer-negotiated rates across facilities and procedure types.
